risk.metric_1: mean |p_rep1 - p_rep2| over non-active DEV origins (two independent repetitions, nested keys)

decision.metric: mean regret between repetitions: |eval_loss(choice_rep1) - eval_loss(choice_rep2)| / eval_loss(none)

rule: choose the smallest M in {8, 32, 128} meeting the tolerance for F and O; budget cap: M_risk <= 32 and M_dec <= 32 (cost per CONF episode); if the tolerance is not met within the cap, keep the cap and report the limit
